rationale: Motor phase inner1 transitions are limited to 12 mm at >=0.30 mm width for the 0.40 A worst-case phase budget. They must independently pass IPC thermal screening on >=17.5 um internal copper, >=700 mm2 continuous grounded inner1 fill, full-width USB ground reference, connectivity and all native/CAM clearances. At 12 mm a 0.30 x 0.0175 mm conductor has approximately 39.4 milliohm resistance, 15.8 mV drop and 6.3 mW loss at 0.40 A. These calculations do not establish bench thermal performance.
USB_construction_reference_rationale: Pair outer edge is 0.330 mm from the centreline. A 0.400 mm construction buffer plus the existing 0.15 mm copper clearance and 0.02 mm grid margin leaves 0.04 mm beyond the 0.20 mm ground-fill setback. Final exact full-track ground-reference geometry remains mandatory.
